condition_mismatches: success_radius_m: manifest 0.05, run did not report it
dwell_s: manifest 1.0, run did not report it

truncated.note: ended before the time limit; their traces stop at the last pre-reset sample and the missing tail is not filled

error_surviving_episodes_only.note: for diagnosis only; the reported result is error_all_episodes

saturation.note: arm_commanded_* is Isaac Lab's PD estimate clipped to the effort limit, not a PhysX measurement, and it saturates even standing still because the arm's 4000 N·m/rad gains far exceed its 1.7-3.3 N·m limits. peak_arm_joint_torque_nm is PhysX's reaction torque: the total load carried through the joint, including gravity and inertia from the links beyond it, not the drive's own torque. It is not comparable to the 1.7-3.3 N·m effort limits and may exceed them without any limit being violated. The legs use an explicit actuator, so their figures are the model's own clipped output.

g1a.criterion: ≥90% reach within 5 cm for ≥1 s continuous, surviving to episode end, with ≤1% falls

interpretation: One controller on one frozen manifest, one simulator seed. A zero-action run of the same manifest is the baseline this must be read against.
